l-m-m3-b03-01.title: Uma b iyalingana, ingabe iyi-perfect square?
l-m-m3-b03-01.goal: Hlola ukuthi isitatimende sokuthi x²+bx+c iyi-perfect square uma b iyalingana siyiqiniso njalo yini, bese uthola futhi uchaze isimo lapho singenjalo (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-m3-b03-01.material: Isitatimende: Ku-x²+bx+c, uma b iyalingana, isibalo sihlala siyi-perfect square. Thola isibalo esikhombisa ukuthi lesi sitatimende siphutha.
l-m-m3-b03-01.s.s1.explain: x²+4x+3=(x+1)(x+3) akuyona isiphumo sezibalo ezimbili ze-linear ezifanayo. Noma b iyalingana, akuyona i-perfect square.
l-m-m3-b03-01.s.s2.model.0: x²+4x+3 ngu-(x+1)(x+3), onezici ezimbili ezihlukile, ngakho akuyona i-perfect square, futhi kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo noma b=4 iyalingana.
l-m-m3-b03-01.s.s2.model.1: Ukuze ibe yi-perfect square, kudingeka c=(b÷2)², kodwa 3 akuyona (4÷2)²=4, ngakho kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.

l-m-m3-b05-23.title: Uma u-tan A×tan B=1, ingabe u-A=B?
l-m-m3-b05-23.goal: Nquma ukuthi isisho esithi "uma u-tan A×tan B=1, bese u-A no-B bayingeli efanayo" siyiqiniso njalo yini, bese uthola futhi uchaza icala lapho kungenjalo (isibonelo esiphikisayo).
l-m-m3-b05-23.material: tan 30°=1/√3, tan 45°=1, tan 60°=√3. Isisho: uma u-tan A×tan B=1, bese u-A no-B bayingeli efanayo. Thola u-A no-B abakhombisa ukuthi lesi sisho siyiphutha.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s1.r.b: Umphumela ungu-3, ngakho awanelisi isimo u-tan A×tan B=1.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s1.r.c: Umphumela ungu-1/3, ngakho awanelisi isimo u-tan A×tan B=1.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s1.r.d: Umphumela ungu-1 futhi u-A=B, ngakho lesi sibonelo sifanelana nesisho.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s1.explain: tan 30°×tan 60°=(1/√3)×√3=1, kodwa 30°≠60°. Izingeli ezimbili ezengeza ku-90° nazo zinika umphumela we-1.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s2.model.0: (1/√3)×√3=1, ngakho isimo siyanelisa, kodwa u-A=30° no-B=60° bayizingeli ezihlukile, ngakho kuyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s2.model.1: U-tan 30° no-tan 60° bayizingxenye eziphambene komunye nomunye, ngakho umphumela wabo ungu-1, kodwa izingeli ezimbili ziyahluka, ngakho isisho siphosile.

l-m-m3-b01-10.title: Isihluthulelo siyini sokuguqula u-x²+bx+c ube ngumphumela?
l-m-m3-b01-10.goal: Nquma ukuthi yimuphi umbandela (ulwazi) odingeka ngempela ukuthola isimo sokuguqula u-x²+bx+c ube ngu-(x+p)(x+q), bese uchaza ukuthi kungani uyikhethile.
l-m-m3-b01-10.material: Ufuna ukuhlukanisa u-x²+bx+c ube ngohlobo lwe-(x+p)(x+q). Uma unwebisa u-(x+p)(x+q), ungabona izimo okufanele p no-q bazihlangabezane.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.prompt: Yiziphi izimo okufanele p no-q bazifeze?
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.a: U-p no-q bangunywa isamba nomphumela, hhayi ngu-b no-c ngokwabo.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.b: Isamba nomphumela kushintshiwe. Uma unwebisa, i-coefficient ka-x ngu-p+q.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s1.explain: (x+p)(x+q)=x²+(p+q)x+pq, ngakho thola izinombolo ezimbili ezinezinombolo p+q=b no-pq=c.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s2.model.0: Ukunwebisa u-(x+p)(x+q) kunikeza u-x²+(p+q)x+pq, ngakho i-coefficient b ka-x kufanele ibe ngu-p+q futhi ithemu elingaguquki c kufanele libe ngu-pq.
l-m-m3-b01-10.s.s2.model.1: Ukuqhathanisa isibalo esinwetshisiwe nama-coefficient ka-x²+bx+c, isamba kufanele sibe ngu-b futhi umphumela kufanele ube ngu-c, ngakho isamba nomphumela wezinombolo ezimbili kuyisihluthulelo.

l-m-m3-b02-06.s.s2.model.0: Amakhoneni amabili aphambene u-B no-D engeza afinyelele ku-180°, ngakho ukwazi u-∠D kuphela kunquma u-∠B.
l-m-m3-b02-06.s.s2.model.1: Ikhoneni eliseduze, ubude, noma radiyasi akunqumi u-∠B, ngakho ikhoneni eliphambene u-∠D liyadingeka.

l-m-m3-b02-09.material: Esikhundleni sokufaka u-x=1 ku-ax²+bx+c=0, sifuna ukusho ngokushesha ukuthi u-x=1 uyimpande yini ngokubheka ama-coefficient kuphela. Kufanele sibheke liphi inani?
l-m-m3-b02-09.s.s1.r.a: I-discriminant isitshela kuphela inani lezixazululo, hhayi ukuthi yimaphi amanani yizimpande.
l-m-m3-b02-09.s.s1.explain: Ukufaka u-x=1 kunikeza u-a+b+c. Uma leli nani lingu-0, bese u-x=1 uyimpande.
l-m-m3-b02-09.s.s2.model.0: Ukufaka u-x=1 kwenza inani lesisho libe ngu-a+b+c, ngakho udinga kuphela ukuhlola ukuthi leli nani lingu-0 yini.
l-m-m3-b02-09.s.s2.model.1: Amanye amanani ngokuka-x=−1 noma inani lezixazululo, ngakho ukuthi u-x=1 uyimpande kungaziwa kuphela ku-a+b+c.

l-m-m3-b02-10.title: Ukwazi ukuthi u-√n uyinombolo yemvelo?
l-m-m3-b02-10.topic: Umbandela wokuthi impande yesikwele ibe yinombolo yemvelo
l-m-m3-b02-10.goal: Ukuthola ukuthi u-√n uyinombolo yemvelo yini, khetha ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi odingekayo ngempela, bese uchaza ukuthi ukhetheleni.
l-m-m3-b02-10.material: Kunombolo yemvelo u-n, sifuna ukwazi ukuthi u-√n uyinombolo yemvelo yini. Siyibhale u-n njengomphumela wezinto eziyinhloko, njenge-12=2²×3, 36=2²×3², no-200=2³×5².
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.prompt: Yimuphi ulwazi olusitshela umbandela wokuthi u-√n abe yinombolo yemvelo?
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.o.a: Ukuthi inombolo yokugcina iyaphindwa ngo-2 yini
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.r.a: 36 no-12 bobabili banenombolo yokugcina eyaphindwa ngo-2, kodwa u-36 kuphela oyinombolo eyisikwele.
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.r.b: 9 no-15 bobabili abaphindwa ngo-2, kodwa u-9 kuphela oyinombolo eyisikwele.
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.o.c: Ukuthi ama-exponent ezinto zonke eziyinhloko ayaphindwa ngo-2 yini
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.r.d: Usayizi wodwa awukwazi ukusho ukuthi iyinombolo eyisikwele yini.
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s1.explain: Uma ama-exponent ezinto zonke eziyinhloko ayaphindwa ngo-2, u-n uyinombolo eyisikwele futhi u-√n uyinombolo yemvelo. U-36 ungu-2²×3².
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s2.model.0: Uma ama-exponent ezinto zonke eziyinhloko ayaphindwa ngo-2, u-n ungabhalwa njenge-(inombolo ethile)², ngakho u-√n uyinombolo yemvelo.
l-m-m3-b02-10.s.s2.model.1: U-12 unama-exponent angu-1 ku-3, futhi u-200 unama-exponent angu-3 ku-2, ngakho ngamunye unama-exponent angaphindwa ngo-2, okusho ukuthi u-√n akayona inombolo yemvelo.

l-m-m3-b03-07.title: Yini okufanele ibe yiqiniso ukuze i-minimum ibe ku-x=2?
l-m-m3-b03-07.goal: Nquma ukuthi yisiphi isilinganiso (ulwazi) esidingekayo ngokuphelele ukuze uthole umsebenzi we-quadratic one-minimum ku-x=2, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani usikhethile.
l-m-m3-b03-07.material: Ufuna umsebenzi we-quadratic y=a(x−p)²+q ube ne-minimum ku-x=2. Cabanga ukuthi yiziphi izimo okufanele zibe yiqiniso.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s1.r.a: q yinani le-minimum. U-x lapho i-minimum ivela khona ngu-p.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s1.r.b: Uma a<0, x=2 inika i-maximum, hhayi i-minimum.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s1.r.d: a no-q akunquli indawo ka-x lapho i-minimum ivela khona.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s1.explain: I-vertex ku-x=p, futhi uma a>0, leyo phoyinti i-minimum. Ngakho p=2 no-a>0.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s2.model.0: U-x lapho i-minimum noma i-maximum ivela khona yi-x-coordinate p ye-vertex, futhi i-minimum uma a>0, ngakho p=2 no-a>0 ziyadingeka.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s2.model.1: Osayizi ba-q no-a abakwazi ukushintsha indawo ye-minimum, ngakho kuyasebenza uma p=2 no-a>0, evulekela phezulu.

l-m-m3-b05-19.material: Ufuna ukuthola ukuthi igrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic ihlangana ne-x-axis yini. Cabanga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oludingeka ngempela.

l-m-m3-b05-19.s.s1.r.a: I-axis yokulinganisa yodwa ayitsheli ukuphakama, ngakho awukwazi ukusho ukuthi ihlangana ne-x-axis yini.
l-m-m3-b05-19.s.s1.r.c: Noma i-y-intercept iphozithivu, ingase ingahlangani ne-x-axis.
l-m-m3-b05-19.s.s1.r.d: Isitshela kuphela ububanzi, ngakho awukwazi ukusho ukuthi ihlangana ne-x-axis yini.
l-m-m3-b05-19.s.s1.explain: Uma i-vertex iphezu kwe-x-axis futhi igrafu ivulekela phezulu, ayihlangani ne-x-axis. Udinga bobabili ukuphakama nesiqondiso ndawonye.
l-m-m3-b05-19.s.s2.model.0: Uma wazi ukuphakama kwe-vertex nokuthi ivulekela phezulu noma phansi, ungasho ukuthi igrafu inqamula i-x-axis yini, ngakho lezi ezimbili ziyadingeka ngempela.
l-m-m3-b05-19.s.s2.model.1: I-y-intercept, i-axis yokulinganisa, nobubanzi akunquli ukuphakama nesiqondiso segrafu, ngakho awukwazi ukusho ukuthi ihlangana ne-x-axis yini.

l-m-m3-b0s6-03.goal: Nquma ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi oludingeka ngempela ukuthola isimo ku-k esenza kube yisibalo se-quadratic, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani uyikhethile.
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.material: U-k uyinombolo engaguquki. Sifuna ukuthola isimo ku-k ukuze (k−2)x²+3x+1=0 kube yisibalo se-quadratic ku-x. Ake sicabange ukuthi sidinga ukuhlola ini.
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.prompt: Udinga ukuhlola ini ukuthola isimo ku-k?
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.o.a: Ukuthi ithemu elingaguquki u-1 alikho u-0 yini
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.r.a: Noma ithemu elingaguquki lingu-0, kuyisibalo se-quadratic inqobo nje uma kunethemu le-x².
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.r.b: Inani lezixazululo yinto okufanele icatshangwe ngemva kokuthi seyibe yisibalo se-quadratic.
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.o.c: Ukuthi i-coefficient ka-x², k−2, ayikho u-0 yini
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.o.d: Ukuthi i-coefficient ka-x, 3, ayikho u-0 yini
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.r.d: U-3 usevele engeyona u-0, futhi ukuthi kuyi-quadratic kunqunywa i-coefficient ka-x².
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.explain: Uma i-coefficient ka-x², k−2, ingu-0, iba yisibalo esilayini. Ngakho k−2≠0, okungukuthi, k≠2.
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s2.model.0: Uma k=2, ithemu le-x² liyanyamalala futhi iba ngu-3x+1=0, ngakho kufanele sihlole ukuthi i-coefficient ka-x², k−2, ayikho u-0 yini.
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s2.model.1: Isibalo se-quadratic sidinga ithemu le-x², ngakho i-coefficient ka-x² kuphela edingekayo, futhi ezinye ama-coefficient nenani lezixazululo akubalulekile.

l-m-m3-b0s6-04.title: Isiqinisekiso siyini sesibalo lapho ungasebenzisa khona ifomula yomehluko wezikwele?
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.goal: Nquma ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi oludingeka ngempela ukuhlukanisa ukuthi yiziphi izibalo ezingahlukaniswa ngefomula u-a²−b², bese uchaza ukuthi kungani uyikhethile.
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.material: Sifuna ukuhlukanisa sisebenzisa u-a²−b²=(a+b)(a−b). Ake sicabange ngesiqinisekiso sokuhlukanisa ukuthi yiziphi izibalo ezifanelana nale fomula.
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.prompt: Isiqinisekiso siyini sokuhlukanisa ukuthi yiziphi izibalo ezingasebenzisa le fomula?
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.r.a: 4x²−9 naye ungu-(2x)²−3², ngakho ama-coefficient akudingeki abe ngu-1.
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.o.b: Amagama amabili ngalinye yisikwele sesibalo esithile, futhi kungumehluko
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.o.c: Amagama amabili ngalinye yisikwele sesibalo esithile, futhi kungumphumela wokungeza
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.r.c: Isamba esinjengo-x²+9 asikwazi ukuhlanganiswa kube ngohlobo lwe-(a+b)(a−b).
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.r.d: Ukuthi ithemu elingaguquki liyi-even yini akunakho ukuhlobana nefomula. U-x²−9 unethemu elingaguquki eliyi-odd.
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s1.explain: a²−b² ungumehluko wamagama amabili enziwe isikwele. 4x²−9=(2x)²−3² naye unalesi simo, ngakho uba ngu-(2x+3)(2x−3).
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s2.model.0: Wonke amagama amabili kufanele abe izikwele nokususa phakathi kwawo ukuze ahlanganiswe njengo-(a+b)(a−b). Ngokungeza, akunakubhalwa njengomphumela, ngakho ukuba ngumehluko yisiqinisekiso.
l-m-m3-b0s6-04.s.s2.model.1: 4x²−9 ungu-(2x)²−3², ngakho ama-coefficient akudingeki abe ngu-1. Isiqinisekiso ukuthi ungumehluko wezikwele yini, ngakho ukuthi ithemu elingaguquki liyi-even noma i-odd akubalulekile.

l-m-m3-b05-25.material: Ake silinganisele ubude bethunzi lensika ephakeme ngo-3 m. Indawo ephakeme yelanga ingu-60° futhi tan 60°≈1.7. Ukuphakama kwensika = ithunzi × tan 60°.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s1.r.a: Lelo yinani lika-1.7÷3. Ukulandelana kokuhlukanisa kuphambene.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu kuthatha ukuphakama nethunzi njengokulinganayo (zilingana kuphela ku-45°).
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s1.explain: Ithunzi = 3÷1.7 ≈ 1.76. Lokho kungu-1.8 m cishe. Njengoba ilanga liphezulu, ithunzi lifushane kunensika.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s2.model.0: Njengoba 3 = ithunzi × 1.7, ithunzi lingu-3÷1.7 ≈ 1.8 m, elifushane kunensika futhi lifanelana nendawo ephakeme engu-60°.
l-m-m3-b05-25.s.s2.model.1: Njengoba u-tan 60° mkhulu kuno-1, ithunzi kufanele lifushane kunokuphakama okungu-3 m, futhi u-3÷1.7 ≈ 1.8 m uyafanelana.

l-m-m3-b0s6-09.s.s2.model.1: Uma ufaka x=−3, uthola 36, ngakho akuyona isixazululo. U-x+3=0 emgqeni wesibili uphutha, futhi x=3 kuyisixazululo esisodwa kuphela.
